objective: Build Hourly Wellness Widget – zero-backend PWA/TWA widget that reminds users to take a 60-second breathing break every hour, with a guided breathing canvas, localStorage streak tracking, and optional home-screen widget.

steps.task: Finalize requirements: hourly local notification, 60s breathing canvas (Canvas API), localStorage streak, widget integration (ambient-lock-widget pattern), minimal dependencies (no backend). Define data model for streak tracking.

Create wireframes for: (1) main widget screen (hourly reminder + breathing canvas), (2) breathing canvas flow (tap → inhale count → exhale count → reset), (3) streak dashboard (localStorage view), (4) settings (notification frequency, theme). Validate against SHHH widget pattern and mindful-break PWA.

Implement widget scaffold using ambient-lock-widget as base. Integrate local notification scheduling (iOS 17+/Android 14). Build breathing canvas with Canvas API (60s cycle, animated circles). Implement localStorage streak logic.
Cross‑platform testing on iOS 17+ and Android 14+ devices. Verify notification frequency, canvas responsiveness, streak persistence, and widget manifest compliance. Fix any platform-specific bugs.
Build TWA/PWA, create APK/AAB/IPA bundles, prepare privacy notice (microphone usage, no data collection), write user guide for voice/tap commands, document deployment steps.
